input.quote: The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no ownership or IP-allocation provision at all. HDI designs, develops and hosts the bespoke Deerskin Site (§§1.1-1.3, 1.6) and the Company supplies all Content (§2.1), yet nothing states who owns the Site, the Content, the developed software or the user, customer and transaction data the Site generates. The nearest provisions are non-ownership controls only: §5.2 gives us artistic and editorial control, §5.3 addresses title to physical Deerskin Products, §6.1 grants HDI a narrow licence of our Marks (which benefits us and is not flagged), and §8.1 treats Content, user information and data merely as Confidential Information. With no assignment, no licence back and no data-ownership sentence, HDI as developer/host would retain rights in the site it builds and control of our customer data, so the clause fails both the preferred and fallback positions and is missing rather than a mere deviation. We therefore insert a single new Section 5.5 at the preferred level: HDI assigns the Site, Content and other deliverables and work product to the Company, retains its pre-existing IP subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence for embedded HDI IP, the Company retains all rights in user, customer and transaction data, and joint ownership is excluded. The fallback (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense) is offered in the comment if HDI insists on retaining title to its platform.

proposal.summary: Insert a new Section 5.5 allocating ownership of the Site, deliverables and Company data to the Company, with HDI retaining pre-existing IP subject to a licence back and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement nowhere allocates ownership of the Site, Content or the customer and transaction data it generates, so we have added Section 5.5: HDI assigns the Site and other deliverables and work product to us, retains its pre-existing IP subject to a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any HDI IP embedded in the deliverables, we retain all rights in user, customer and transaction data, and no IP is jointly owned. If HDI must keep title to its platform, our fallback is a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the deliverables for our business.

ops.text: Ownership. The Company shall own all right, title and interest in the Site, the Content and all other deliverables and work product created for the Company under this Agreement, and HDI hereby assigns the same to the Company. HDI retains all right, title and interest in its pre-existing intellectual property and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to any such HDI intellectual property embedded in the Site or other deliverables. The Company retains all right, title and interest in all user, customer and transaction data collected through the Site. No intellectual property shall be owned jointly by the Parties.
